facts.action: 打电话给 Julie，问「能不能把鬼从房产里赶出去」；Julie 笑答租约随死亡失效，并讲了一个 NYCHA 客户的故事：与伴侣同住几十年，伴侣死后因不在租约上被扫地出门，客户本人也病了。

extra_anchors.anchor: Can you evict a ghost from a property?

facts.action: 闪回 Seward Park 高中第一天：Julie 坐在代数课后排她身后，耳语说这地方从前是监狱；两人翘了第三节课；Julie 递给她第一根抽了不咳的烟，还讲 Victoria Woodhull 在此坐过牢、竞选过总统。
facts.anchor: Did you know this place used to be a jail?

extra_anchors.anchor: she handed me the first cigarette I ever smoked without coughing
Do you know who Victoria Woodhull was?

facts.action: 闪回高三：Julie 在英语课递纸条，当晚两人第一次互相探索身体；此后恋情起起落落（各自与别的女人睡、不再说话、重逢再睡），最后淡出，成了朋友。
facts.anchor: she passed me a note in English class

extra_anchors.anchor: i wanna come over and listen to sticky fingers.

facts.action: 在俱乐部（文中回忆指向 Danceteria）：Julie 嫌今晚「很男」；叙述者挤到吧台，把本该给 Julie 的两杯酒都喝了，随后看见舞池挤满鬼魂——与活人同舞、彼此调笑。
facts.anchor: I had never seen so many ghosts at a time.

extra_anchors.anchor: I slid over some cash and downed one, then the other, even though it was meant for Julie.

facts.action: 音乐停、灯大亮，鬼魂消失；她担心 Manhattan Remediation 像超自然扫黄队一样来抓那些只想玩个痛快的鬼，说「我自己不配有一个」；Julie 找到她，一句「You okay?」后，两人牵手一起离开。
facts.anchor: She put her hand in mine and we left together.

extra_anchors.anchor: what if they swept in like a supernatural vice squad and rounded up all the ghosts who were just trying to have a good time?
